item.title: AI Coding Team Setup Guide 2026: How to Roll Out AI Tools Across Engineering
item.description: The difference between a team that achieves 47% productivity gains and one that sees 12% comes down to one thing: process, not tool selection. According to a 2025 enterprise study of 250 organizations, structured rollouts consistently outperform ad hoc adoption by a 4x margin. Yet 95% of enterprise GenAI pilots produce zero measurable P&L impact (MIT State of AI in Business 2025), and the reasons are almost never about the tools themselves.
